scope: SDK14 host image-preload publication and official main/worker functional lifecycle. No Game FPS or natural-GC acceptance is claimed.

sdk.runtime_policy: Reused verified SDK10 production WASM, opt2, profile_mode none, no development/preview/phase/sampling features, UI0.6. This is not the separately build-blocked fused-copy runtime.

fixture.changes: Only an independent 2x2 PNG texture2d declaration and player.image-assets.json required startup group were added. Existing Game script, stimuli and visual expectations were preserved.

publication.commands: The actual packed SDK CLI export and packed SDK Node publisher both exited0. Full argv/stdout/stderr are preserved under .cache/sdk14-preload-official-validation.
publication.publisher_origin: SDK; tool and validator were checked against its indexed manifest.

actual_browser.instrumentation: A cache copy of the official lifecycle runner retains its original nine phase assertions/stimuli. An additive passive decode observer calls the original HTMLImageElement.decode exactly once, attaches an observation reaction and returns the original Promise unchanged. It records completion before the READY console event. Existing read-only host metrics later confirm required_entries=required_ready_entries=1. No extra Core command, decode invocation, renderer, clock or gameplay change was introduced.
actual_browser.ordering_scope: Decode timestamps prove event order within each page only. Broker counts were inspected after the lifecycle run, not directly sampled from a private broker at READY. The production barrier and source/Node tests establish that required ready counts gate Core startup.

visual_inspection.additional_parent_spot_check: Root independently viewed main/initial.png and worker/restored.png and confirmed the expected colored layers, Canvas text and context recovery.
visual_inspection.finding: Initial and restored main/worker screenshots retain expected crop/alpha/order, Canvas HUD text and Pause/Resume button behavior, with no error overlay. The independent preload-only image does not alter visible Game artwork.

limits: Functional export/publication and actual official-player lifecycle only; no FPS, natural-GC frequency, leak-free or release-readiness claim.
The required image is an independent preload-only fixture resource; this does not validate a particular Game's resource grouping or cache invalidation policy.
No Rust build, Game Product write or fused-copy WASM execution occurred. Browser work finished and closed before the subsequent Game FPS quiet window.
